name: residual_geometry_pilot_reproduction
purpose: Re-derive the completed residual-geometry pilot's numbers with scikit-learn, using the pilot's own fold assignment, before any corrected or extended analysis is attempted.

states.numbering: state 0 is the embedding output; states 1-48 are transformer-block outputs
states.degenerate_policy: zero-variance states are scored, flagged, and excluded from any maximum; an undefined statistic is written as empty, never as NaN

folds.rationale: the pilot built folds with a bespoke round-robin deal; an independently constructed StratifiedKFold gives different held-out sets and therefore different numbers, so reproduction must import the assignment rather than rebuild it

probe.tol_rationale: a convergence setting, not part of the estimand. The reference pilot minimised this same objective to a gradient tolerance of 1e-06, explicitly noting that this is tighter than scikit-learn's default tol=1e-04. Left at the default, lbfgs stops short of the optimum and state 45 reproduces only to 6.3e-05; at 1e-06 it reproduces to 3.7e-07, which is the reference file's own six-decimal rounding. Metrics are identical at 1e-05, 1e-06, 1e-08 and 1e-12.
probe.scaler_scope: fitted inside each training fold only

outputs.figures_note: publication figures belong to the corrected analysis, not to reproduction

explicitly_not_run: any analysis of the withheld class
any routing or expert feature extraction
